Fin resolves over 2 million conversations weekly, is doubling growth year on year, and has surpassed $400M in annual recurring revenue. Founded as Intercom in 2011, we revolutionized modern customer communication. When it became clear AI would fundamentally reshape the industry, we reinvented the company – rebuilding our product, infrastructure, and team around AI. Still founder-led, we're one of the largest and fastest-growing private software companies in the world, with more than 1,400 people across six global offices. We’re only getting started. Now with Salesforce, we can bring Fin into more businesses, making perfect customer experiences possible for millions more people. Our vision for the future of customer experience We believe businesses are best served by a single agent with full context across the entire customer journey, delivering experiences that were never before possible. Originally founded as Intercom 14 years ago, we were one of the fastest companies to grow from $1m to $50m ARR. Today, still founder-led, we are one of the largest private software companies in the world and the leader in the new category of AI Customer Agents. Fin aims to create extraordinary value for both employees and investors by tackling work worth trillions across service, sales, and success. We want to be a defining AI company—one people point to when they tell the story of this era. And we want to continue building a special company culture that shapes careers and stays with people long after they leave. We hold a very high bar, but for the particularly ambitious and brilliant, there are few better places to work. Intercom pricing has two components: Seats: You pay per teammate based on your plan (Essential, Advanced, Expert) Usage: You pay for what you use (e.g. Fin outcomes, messaging channels) All plans include access to Intercom and Fin AI Agent. Want a tailored estimate? Use the pricing calculator . How is Fin AI Agent priced? Fin is priced at $0.99 per outcome . An outcome is counted when: A customer confirms their issue is resolved, or They don’t ask for more help after Fin responds, or Fin completes a workflow (Procedure), including handoffs You’re only charged once per conversation, even if multiple questions are answered. Can I use Fin with my existing helpdesk? Yes. Fin can be used with tools like Salesforce and others. Pricing: $0.99 per outcome Minimum monthly commitment applies (e.g. 50 outcomes) No seat costs No setup, integration, or platform fees What plans does Intercom offer? Intercom offers three plans: Essential Advanced Expert Your plan determines: Seat price Feature access Included capabilities (e.g. Lite seats on higher tiers) What is a seat (Full vs Lite)? Full seat: Paid. Required for teammates who interact with customers and use core features. Lite seat: Free (on Advanced/Expert). Limited access for internal collaboration. Only Full seats can send messages or fully use features like outbound content. Are there additional usage charges? Yes. Beyond seats, pricing is usage-based for certain features: Fin AI Agent: $0.99 per outcome WhatsApp: Charged per conversation (varies by volume/direction) SMS: Charged per message (varies by region) Email campaigns: Charged per bulk email sent Phone: Usage-based (varies) Inbound support (e.g. responding to customer emails) is included. What is Proactive Support Plus? An optional add-on for outbound engagement. $99/month includes 500 messages Covers: Product Tours, Surveys, In-app messages, Mobile Push, Carousels Additional messages are charged per unit How much is Copilot? Copilot is an optional add-on at $29 per agent/month billed annually , or $35 per agent/month billed monthly, for unlimited usage. Copilot is a personal AI assistant in the Inbox that helps your team resolve conversations faster. Every agent also gets 10 Copilot and 10 AI Auto-translation conversations free each month. What is the Pro add-on? Pro is an optional add-on at $99/month , which includes analysis of 1,000 conversations/month and 2,000 credits per month. Pro is a set of advanced AI features for managing and improving your support operation. It includes Operator, an agent for customer operations, plus features that help you analyze performance, monitor quality, identify trends, and continuously improve Fin. Credits are the unit used to measure and charge for Operator usage. Every Pro workspace receives monthly credits, and the number of credits included scales with conversation volume. If you use more credits than what’s included in Pro, you can buy additional credits at $0.01 per credit. Simple actions use fewer credits, while more complex work, like analyzing large sets of conversations, building automation, or testing changes, uses more. You can track usage, set alerts, and use hard limits to control spend. Do I need a contract? No. Monthly or annual self-serve plans are available (Essential, Advanced) Contracts are optional and required for: Enterprise needs Premier Support / onboarding Custom terms What’s the minimum to get started? 1 Full seat minimum No required platform fees beyond that Usage (e.g. Fin, messaging) is pay-as-you-go This makes it easy to start small and scale. Is there a free trial? Yes. 14-day free trial No credit card required Includes all features, Fin, and add-ons You only pay once you choose a plan and add payment details. How do I change my plan or seats? You can: Upgrade/downgrade plans Add/remove seats Add or remove add-ons Handled directly in your workspace (or via Sales if under contract). Downgrades typically take effect at renewal. Are there discounts available? Yes.
